text:
alex: Customer (acme-inc) opened an SR — users can't access a project or hit project-scoped APIs after their IdP rotated session claims. UI shows permission denied; API returns 403. Root report at 1795502468.

lina: Any quick checks we can run before escalating?

alex: Repro steps provided by customer: sign in via Okta SSO, click org -> switch to project -> UI modal: "You don't have permission to view this project." API repro: use OAuth token from callback to call project keys endpoint -> 403. Example they sent: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ey..." https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/abc123/keys
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"project.access_denied","reason":"membership not found"}
```

jen: Sounds like claim mapping drift. Did they change the groups claim key or rename a group? That would break our membership resolution for active sessions.

oliver: I checked SCIM logs for acme-inc (redacted link): scim delta at 2026-12-01T03:21Z shows group rename: "prod-access" -> "prod_access_v2".

idp-sync-bot: scim-sync job 2026-12-01 03:22:01 completed; summary: 124 users modified, 12 group rename events, 0 fatal errors. Job id: sc-20261201-03.

alex: Customer notes they rotated session/claims in Okta around the same time. Some users still have tokens with the old group alias, and our mapping no longer finds the membership.

lina: Quick mitigation: ask affected users to fully sign out of Okta (clear Okta cookies), then sign back in — forces new token with updated claims. Also trigger Admin -> Org -> Force SCIM resync in the console to reapply group->project bindings.

jen: Longer-term fix: our OIDC claim mapping should accept multiple claim keys and support aliasing renamed groups. For now we can add a one-off mapping alias: map "prod_access_v2" -> existing project role "prod-access" for acme-inc. That will make legacy tokens still resolve.

oliver: Started a resync job with alias mapping applied. Job id rs-20261201-08. Will monitor logs.

idp-sync-bot: resync job rs-20261201-08 finished at 2026-12-01T03:29:49Z. Result: 12 users restored to project role "writer"; 3 service accounts unchanged.

alex: Customer reports console access restored for affected users after sign-out/sign-in + resync. Note: API tokens minted before re-login still failed — they rotated their tokens as a follow-up.

lina: Send the customer a short runbook: 1) Ask users to sign out/in. 2) Rotate long-lived API tokens. 3) If group renames are planned, add alias mapping in our admin mapping table or run resync post-change.

oliver: I've attached the resync job id and SCIM delta (redacted) to the SR and flagged engineering for a claim-mapping enhancement.

alex: Customer confirmed everything looks good after following steps. Will keep SR open for 24h, then close if no regressions. :thumbsup:
